keepalive._doc: Raycast's `raycastbot` auto-stales any PR with no activity for 7 days, then auto-closes after another 7. The previous PR #27618 died this way. keepalive triggers a bump comment if last activity > afterDays AND no prior bump in last minBumpGapDays.

tracks._note: PR #28376 supersedes auto-stale'd #27618. Appends a single community entry to extensions/model-context-protocol-registry/src/registries/builtin/entries.ts (+12) + CHANGELOG.md (+4) + README.md row (+1). Matches Alai #27264 pattern.
